'''Shadday Potkin''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[Jedi Master]] within the [[Jedi Order]], the guardians of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Potkin attended a briefing given by Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] being conducted by the Republic in the ongoing [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The briefing was held in one of the [[Jedi Temple communication center|briefing rooms]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

After the briefing concluded, Potkin was one of the last to leave the room, walking out beside another human Jedi as [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] entered the room.<ref name="ROTS" /> Potkin was [[Force-sensitive]] and had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The Jedi Master wore a set of brown [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] including brown [[boot]]s.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadday Potkin appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The briefing room scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[August 8]], [[2003]].<ref name="Archive">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'',<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> which was released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/mxQvt|archivedate=2022-04-24}}</ref> The name is a combination of the surnames of designer [[Usana Shadday]] and production manager [[Noah Potkin]], both of whom worked on the book.<ref name="Dressing" />
